======

This is a torrent that contains the latest version of Custom Maid 3D 2(version 1.58.1) and with all of the game’s DLC preinstalled. All of the DLC that was released before April 20th, 2018 is included.

It is ideal for people wanting to try the game for the first time (but don’t want to spend hours installing DLC) and for veteran players who need a fresh reinstall. Only original files are included.

If you need mod support or translations please consider getting Sybaris. There are many different packages of Sybaris that players have put together and I will list one in the comments when the latest recommended one becomes available. As a fair warning, please don’t use the Hongfire Patch with this version as it is over two years old and will break your game.
